name: Reflektit Try-On
author: moatazhjaiji01

sections.description:
Shoppers press “Try it on” under the add-to-cart button and Reflektit’s popup opens
with that product. The popup asks for the shopper’s consent before any photo leaves
their browser. This plugin stores nothing about shoppers.

External services

This plugin connects to Reflektit (https://reflektit.com), the try-on service of the
shop owner’s Reflektit account. When a shopper presses “Try it on”, their browser
loads Reflektit’s script from the address set in Settings > Reflektit Try-On, with the
shop’s website ID. Reflektit’s popup then shows the product’s name, price, short
description and image. A shopper’s photo is sent to Reflektit and its image provider
only after the shopper ticks the popup’s consent box. Nothing is sent before the
button is pressed.

Terms: https://reflektit.com/terms
Privacy: https://reflektit.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Register your site’s address in the Reflektit dashboard and switch photo try-on on.
  2. Upload this folder to wp-content/plugins and activate it.
  3. Settings > Reflektit Try-On: paste the website ID, choose Glasses or Clothing, save.

The site must be served over HTTPS. Product images on another host (a CDN) are served
through your site at /wp-json/reflektit/v1/image/, so no CORS setup is needed.

0.1.1

  • The product image route checks password protection with WordPress core’s post_password_required().

0.1.0

  • First release: “Try it on” button on WooCommerce product pages.
